Will run: claude mcp add --scope user --env 'HERDR_PANE_ID=${HERDR_PANE_ID:-}' --env 'HERDR_SOCKET_PATH=${HERDR_SOCKET_PATH:-}' --transport stdio herdr-dots -- $HOME/opt/herdr-dots/bin/herdr-dots mcp --config-dir $HOME/cfg --state-dir $HOME/state

+     "args": [

+       "--state-dir",
+       "$HOME/state"
+     ],
+     "command": "$HOME/opt/herdr-dots/bin/herdr-dots",
+     "env": {
+       "HERDR_PANE_ID": "${HERDR_PANE_ID:-}",
+       "HERDR_SOCKET_PATH": "${HERDR_SOCKET_PATH:-}"
+     },
+     "type": "stdio"
+   }
+ }
Backs up $HOME/.claude.json first.
